snippet.title: Bytes and Knights - ADVENTURE - Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Bytes and Knights is a full-scale digital TCG set within an RPG world, packed with deep strategy and unique mechanics. Explore the streets of your new city, collect cards, build your own deck, and battle increasingly challenging opponents. Each new card unlocks new playstyles and brings you closer to uncovering what really lies hidden beneath the city.

Features include:
- Unique TCG gameplay experience
- 20+ different opponents to battle that range from simple difficulty to insane
- Head-to-head multiplayer!
- Arcade ladder mode
- In-game tutorial and gameplay instructions
- Vast world to explore and interesting NPC's to talk to
- 60+ cards to find, collect and build a competitive deck with

Originally released on the Arduboy, this game is coming to PC and Switch, with plans for release on other retro game systems. (Maybe PS Vita?? 🫨) If you prefer to play the TCG in-person, there is a physical version of the game set to be released, as well!

Planned Release Date: October 20th, 2026
